title: Full-project GitHub-only NEXY spec audit prompt
scope: Create a complete audit-only prompt that inventories every NEXY.AI system from the attached design/spec file, audits the whole GitHub repository against applicable requirements, emits detailed tables, loops through clean re-audits, and generates a repair command for a separate executor.
inputs_summary: User requested exhaustive whole-project auditing against the real design/spec file, system-by-system tabulation, repeated re-audits until no new findings, and a fix command for the implementation chat.
sources: prior protected-branch and GitHub-only audit constraints from this conversation
actions: Grounded prompt in the design file's DOC-A/B/C/D/E authority model
Added mandatory full system inventory and scope classification
Added system-by-system and cross-system audit tables
Added GitHub-only repository audit and protected branch exclusion
Added repeated clean-audit loop and separate master repair command generation

claims_proofs.claim: Build obligation should come from DOC-C, while DOC-B constrains system law and DOC-D is product design.
claims_proofs.proof: Attached design/spec explicitly states DOC-A vision, DOC-B system law, DOC-C build spec, DOC-D product design, DOC-E deployment evidence, and build obligation comes from DOC-C.

claims_proofs.claim: The audit must classify excluded/deferred systems instead of treating every historical/raw-canon mention as a build requirement.
claims_proofs.proof: Attached design/spec explicitly lists vNEXT includes, excluded capabilities, deferred capabilities, and a scope-creep law.

tests_results: Prompt-generation task only; no NEXY implementation test/build/deploy executed.
successes: Created a design-file-driven, GitHub-only, audit-only control prompt with exhaustive system tables and iterative re-audit closure.
decisions: Allowed evidence sources are the attached authoritative design/spec file and the designated GitHub repository only.
The protected branch ai/nexy-24x7-autonomous-do-not-touch remains completely excluded.
Three consecutive clean full audits with changed traversal orders are required before audit closure, subject to stable spec and HEAD.
Audit chat only generates a repair package; it does not mutate the product.
unresolved: Actual authoritative target branch must be resolved at execution time without using the protected branch.
risks: A 293-page design file contains legacy/vision material, so scope classification is mandatory to avoid false requirements.
No audit can prove absence of all possible bugs; closure is limited to audited scope and evidence.
limits: This task creates the audit command, not the audit results.
rollback: No NEXY.AI changes; supersede this prompt if requirements change.
next_actions: Run the generated prompt in the dedicated NEXY audit chat with the design file attached and GitHub connected.
dependencies: GitHub read access to goif74945-crypto/NEXY.AI- excluding protected branch
